Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs

At-tier DELTA review of a follow-up PR. PR #33510 merged from the queue at its old head `d00151d4` (squash `41b64bb08cfe62ebc9dcb3459169daa383406b23`), carrying record 6886666661 (PASS, should-fix S3, nits N1 to N7). The fix commit `f3269534` was reviewed at tier on that base (PASS, S3 closed, N4 and N6 fixed, new nits N8 and N9). This head is that commit cherry-picked onto the squash: one commit, parent `41b64bb0`, 3 files, +25 / -8. Read with `git show` and `git diff` from the local object store, plus card #33484 with its two comments, the PR body and file list, and the head's check-runs.

Gate verdicts on this head: 47 check-runs; 21 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed, and 3 STILL RUNNING at the time of reading: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Test Core (1/8)`, `Test Core (2/8)`. Completed green and relevant here: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, the four `Type Check` runs. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` is the run that carries the pm self-tests and the line ratchet, so this PASS is conditional on it and the two Test Core shards concluding success on this same SHA; the seat reads them before landing. The PR body's own gate list is a report and was not used as evidence.

### ① Derived judgments

- Patch identity: confirmed. `git diff d00151d4 f3269534` and `git diff 41b64bb0 15d3a1b6` are byte-identical (same stable patch-id `ae9b05e0`). Right.
- Base identity: `git diff d00151d4 41b64bb0` is EMPTY over `scripts/pm/**`, `scripts/invoked-as.mjs` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`. That covers `dispatch.mjs`, both skill files and everything `dispatch.mjs` imports (`../../invoked-as.mjs`, `check-half-states`, `fleet-roster`, `label-write`, `write-pace`, `post-stamped`, `./ops`, `./validate`, `./execute`). `main` has since moved 4 commits past `41b64bb0`; none touches those paths. Nothing the patch reads changed, so the prior round's reading of the code transfers whole.
- `dispatch.mjs`: the relay door's accept set narrows by one case: a stroke whose LAST `issue_patch` carrying a `state` says `open` is judged as leaving an OPEN card, whatever the read says. `stateGuardRows` rows gain a `reopens` boolean, additive, one consumer (`judgeStateGuard`, same file). Right: it is card item 1 applied to the card the stroke leaves. No exit code and no read count moves.
- `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`: the stateless-door floor goes 8 to 10. Counted in the head's tree: exactly 10 `t(` cases between `battery(STATELESS_DOOR_BATTERY)` and the next battery. Right, headroom 0.
- `SKILL.md`, `triage-duties.md`: one line each, edited in place. Line counts 319 and 103, equal to `41b64bb0`; `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not in the diff and no ceiling moves. Right.
- Nothing under `packages/**` and no published surface moves.

### ② Semver level

The PR carries `skip-changeset` and no changeset file; `Check Changeset` is green. The diff publishes nothing (`scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` only). That matches.

Clause-②: no. Right: no published schema or accept set is in the diff. The PR body says `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Linkage: the PR body says 「Follow-up to #33484 (PR #33510)」 and carries no closing keyword. Right: #33484 is already closed as completed by #33510, and `PR-body guards` is green.
- S3 (should-fix, record 6886666661): closed at this head, see ④.
- N4 and N6: fixed on the prose faces in place, see ④.
- N1, N2, N3, N5, N7 (record 6886666661) and N8, N9 (the prior delta record): untouched by this diff and stand as recorded. The PR body says they are filed on #33516; that card is outside this review's inputs, so the seat confirms it carries them before landing.
- Open question on #33484 (does a done-and-gated `pm:blocked` card keep its assignee?): answer A stands, and the state table now says it (N4).
- No new dev flag and no new open question arrives with this PR. Nothing is escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

**S3, read in `stateGuardRows` and `judgeStateGuard` on this head.** Each `issue_patch` carrying `state` sets `closes = (state is closed)` and `reopens = (state is open)` on the card's row, so the last one in file order decides both and they are never both true. `judgeStateGuard` hands `refuseStatelessWrite` the state `open` when `reopens`, else the read's state. `validate.mjs` admits `state` as `open` or `closed` only. `refuseStatelessWrite` (label-write, unchanged) returns null on `closed`, on `closes` and on a pull, and otherwise applies the strip half and the holder half. Tried again against this tree:

- reopen plus strip of the last state on a card that reads closed, in either order: the strip makes the row judged, `reopens` is true wherever the patch sits, the predicate sees an open card with no state: refused, exit 2, nothing sent. This is the S3 scenario and it is closed.
- close plus strip: `closes` true, the row is filtered out, nothing is read. The legal exit, unchanged.
- close then reopen on one card: ends `reopens`, judged open. Reopen then close: ends `closes`, not judged. A later `issue_patch` with no `state` leaves both flags alone. Each matches the card the stroke leaves.
- reopen plus `pm:queue` on and `pm:dispatched` off, closed card, no assignee: passes on one GET. With a residual assignee it is refused by the holder half until the stroke unassigns: answer A, a correct refusal.
- `state: open` on a card that reads open: no change. A pull: never judged, as before.

The header sentence and the jsdoc say exactly this. The fix asks label-write's predicate and restates no rule. Holds.

**The two self-test cases.** Case one drives the CLI non-dry with reopen plus the strip on a card read as `closed`: exit 2, zero sent, `STATELESS_RULE` in the refusal; it would fail on `41b64bb0`, so it pins the fix. Case two drives reopen plus the next state: exit 0 on one GET. Floor 10 against 10 registered.

**N4, `SKILL.md` assignee row.** The row now ends 「入停放态(queue/blocked/hold)同笔摘」. That is the door's holder half (`PARKED_STATE_LABELS`, all three, no carve-out) and it settles the done-and-gated `pm:blocked` case: the assignee goes in the stroke that parks the card. The queue row H24 quotes is untouched. Measured: the row is 277 bytes against the widest-table-row pin of 341 (widest rows still lines 109 and 159 at 341); 319 lines. Holds.

**N6, `triage-duties.md` human floor.** 「卡的命运(关 not planned、非 hold 的降级、撤回、砍半)」: a downgrade stays on the maintainer's floor except the one the hold rule itself makes (p3 in the hold stroke, `Restart-grade:` recorded), which the ruling on #33484 covers. Narrowed by exactly that ruled case. Measured: line 91 is 119 bytes under the 120-byte cap; 103 lines. No script in the head's tree quotes either edited phrase. Holds.

**Regression sweep.** The diff touches only the two functions, their jsdoc, one header sentence, the floor and the two cases. `readStateGuard`, the kind rule, the no-token path and every other battery are untouched, and the base under them is byte-identical to the one the prior round read. None found.

**Findings.**

- **N10 · nit** (bookkeeping, no file): the prior delta record gives the edited `SKILL.md` row as 278 bytes and the `triage-duties.md` line as 120 bytes, at the cap. Measured on this head they are 277 and 119 (the earlier figures counted the newline). The PR body's 119 is right. No effect on the contract; nothing to fix in the tree.
- N8 (a reopen-only stroke is not read) and N9 (case one does not assert the single GET) from the prior delta record still hold at this head, unchanged, as nits for the follow-up card.

No must-fix and no should-fix. S3, N4 and N6 are closed at this head. The nits end the round. Landing waits on `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Test Core (1/8)`, `(2/8)` concluding success on `15d3a1b6ebed94b9240ecc7ff97054a2e6cbec7f`.
